answer: I would bet my own seat on Pewter packer pewter proof poured at the casting floor, because each pewter is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record is public and anyone can check it. 441 seats means 441 proofs at 128 POA apiece, and the 56448 POA leaves the farm's hands before the epoch starts. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. A sonnet can be painted, a knoll can be borrowed, but a zephyr must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
